subject.title: Crons ejecutaron mensajes de WhatsApp a la 1 AM fuera de horario y no se podían detener

question: Should OpenClaw make cron remove/gateway stop an immediate cancellation surface for in-flight outbound cron sends, or add a separate emergency-stop command while landing the replay-boundary fix through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92398 or a replacement?
rationale: Current code only partially supports run-id cancellation for detached cron task runs, while the issue asks for a user-facing operational guarantee across cron execution and outbound delivery.

options.title: Land replay boundary and design emergency stop
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92398 or a replacement for schedule activation, then add an explicit operator command that aborts active cron work and blocks new fires.

options.title: Make cron remove abort active runs
options.body: Treat deleting a job as a hard cancellation signal for any in-flight execution of that job, accepting the stronger compatibility change.

options.title: Keep cancellation task-scoped only
options.body: Limit this issue to restart replay and document that active sends must be canceled through task controls or process shutdown.

recommendation.title: Land replay boundary and design emergency stop
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92398 or a replacement for schedule activation, then add an explicit operator command that aborts active cron work and blocks new fires.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/task cancellation history and active review context make this the best available routing owner for the product boundary decision.
